overview: From 2026-11-12 to 2026-11-13, ethereum-optimism/optimism had 3 new PRs (0 merged), 0 new issues, and 4 active contributors.

topIssues.title: op-interop-filter: Take the chain set from the dependency set
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
op-interop-filter takes its chain set from its `--l2-rpcs` entries, not from the dependency set. An extra `--l2-rpcs` entry makes a chain outside the dependency set a valid source. The filter then approves executing messages that op-supernode invalidates, and each invalid message causes a reorg.

Make the filter read the dependency set. It must reject an RPC for a chain that is not in the dependency set.

Does not block launch.

Filed by Claude from the Lagoon interop FMA (FM19).

topPRs.title: op-interop-filter: Require backfill to cover the message expiry window
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
The filter now refuses to start when `--backfill-duration` is shorter than `--message-expiry-window`. With a shorter backfill, the logs DB does not hold old blocks that valid initiating messages can be in. The filter then returns `SkippedData` for those messages, and op-reth evicts valid transactions.

Operators who use the default (168h) see no change. An operator who sets a shorter backfill gets a startup error that names both values. The public docs gave `24h` as the backfill default, which now fails the check. This PR corrects the docs to the real default of 168h.

The devstack filter used a 30s backfill. It now uses the expiry window. Devstack chains are new, so ingestion still starts at genesis.

Closes https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/23938

Reviews: `go-code-reviewer` ran, and this PR applies its findings. I skipped `interop-reviewer`, because this change only adds config validation and does not change message validation. The security review has not run yet. It must run before this PR is ready for review.

topPRs.title: docs: Document interop message and expiry limitations
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
The interop docs do not list the cases where a send's assets can be lost or a relay can't happen. This PR documents them, so the public docs act as the known issue register.

`L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger.sendMessage` and `SuperchainETHBridge.sendETH` do not check that the destination chain is in the source chain's interop cluster. A message to a chain outside the cluster can't be relayed. It also can't be expired, because `L1CrossDomainMessenger.relayUndeliveredMessage` accepts an export only from a portal that the shared `ETHLockbox` authorizes. The message passing page said that `sendMessage` checks the destination. It does not, so this PR removes that claim.

A deposit can't relay a message, because `CrossL2Inbox.validateMessage` reverts for deposits. After the 7-day window, the only recovery is to expire the message and undo the send.

A new "Known limitations" section on the message expiration page lists each case where expiry can't return the assets to their owner:
- the destination is outside the interop cluster
- the sending application does not support expiry
- the sender can't claim the refund, or can't use or pass on the refunded ETH
- the send came from L1 through `L2CrossDomainMessenger`, or from a relayed message
- the target had no code when the message was relayed

The message passing and ETH bridge pages link to this section. This PR changes only the English pages. The translation bot updates the `ko/` copies.

Part of ethereum-optimism/optimism#23806.

topPRs.title: op-core: Test that the message expiry period exceeds the expiry window
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
A source chain can expire a message after `L2_TO_L2_MESSAGE_EXPIRY_PERIOD` (8 days). A destination accepts an executing message for `MessageExpiryTimeSecondsInterop` (7 days). If the period is not longer than the window, a destination can relay a message that the source already refunded. Each value has its own test, but no test compared them.

The new test reads the constant from `Constants.sol` as text, so it needs no contracts build. There is no effect on users.

Closes https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/23935
